content: Iesu Ka Satana
Dewaia iakwa, Nuana Ahihinata Iesu taini neiei meagai anata wayahina. Iuna tenoke nau‑wawani nua goyogoyoi ai tau veimea ana‑dibidibiei goyona wayahina.
Ka auyewa ai yau 40 ka ioyoma ai yau 40 nihenia, Iesu eha tꞌ‑amam, wayahina am navovo ananina.
Ka tau vito‑nubu vinꞌ‑omo, ivona, “Aituhu wamke Yaubada natuna, am pata hanu taina eveimeyei ivi‑aniani.”
Ka Iesu ivona, “Iginuma nihenina veimea mamaei vivane,

content.text: kate tomotau yawai Yaubada yana vona

content: Iakwa, e nua goyogoyoi ai tau veimea Iesu taini neiei meagai ahihinata wayahina, vivane Ierusalem, e Manua Vito‑pota hetana vaneyei.
E wayahina vonei, ivona, “Aituhu wamke Yaubada natuna, akanai nau‑wawanim taina wayahina eni‑ubau, ka eha enꞌ‑aniga, iuna Iginuma nihenina ivona,
Ka Iesu ivona, “Kadu aitam vona Iginuma nihenina mamaei ivona,

Ka nua goyogoyoi ai tau veimea Iesu taini‑havinei oya ananina hetana, ka tanoi wayahina tauna pai veimea kaikaiwabo tanopi habuhabuna nihenina viwavenei Iesu dueyei. Kadu pai veimea‑naia ai tau veimea didigai viwavenei.
Ka kadu vito‑nubu‑havinei, ivona, “Aituhu ena‑iwaodu wayahiua, pai veimea tanoi habuhabuna avenem, eveimeyei, kadu didigana aitamoata aitamoata wayahia avenem, vivane didigam.”
Wayahina, Iesu yapoi, ivona, “Satana, eni‑tawaneu! Iginuma nihenina veimea mamaei, ivona,

content.text: ka tauna ana heta yana vona evi‑ateteyei.’”

content: Iakwa, nua goyogoyoi ai tau veimea Iesu ni‑tawanei, ka munia, anelose Yaubada wayahina ivinꞌ‑omo iaivaitei.
Iesu Ya Paisewa Vi‑putu
Ka munia, avaha Iesu vane nononi vivane Ioni manua yohona nihenina iboui, akanai tauna mavina ine papani Galili wayahina.

Ka tauna ya meagai naona Nasareta ni‑tawanei ka omo meagai Kapenaum wayahina, e tenoke mamaei, ya meagai vovouna. Meagai‑nana Navu Galili maupwanina, papani taina vivane me Sebuluni ka me Napitali yai papani.
Nonova tau apa‑taputapu Isaia dewana mai‑haeyei Iginuma nihenina, ka dewaia ivinꞌ‑omo deina, ivona,

content.text: “Me Sebuluni kadu me Napitali yai papani,
Papani taina vivane taui eha me Iudea

content: Ka avaha Iesu ubo‑tamana meagai Kapenaum wayahina, tauna ya nau‑wahe vi‑putu, ivona, “Yami dewa goyona wayahina unua‑vinana, iuna Yaubada ya pai veimea vi‑maupwani.”
Iesu Tau Nau‑agida Vi‑nua‑dadanei
Aitam tuta Iesu Navu Galili tania ni‑awana, e tau nau‑agida ainua dueyei inau‑agida navua. Aitam ana wava Simoni, tauna kadu ivi‑wahani Pita, ka vaneina ana wava Aniduru.
Ka Iesu honei, ivona, “Uvi‑munieu, e aviwavenemi medeina tomotau uvi‑onai.”
Ka ivo‑kwayavoni, ka yai agida ini‑tawanei, ka ivi‑putu Iesu ivi‑muniei.
Ka Iesu neine, e tau nau‑agida aitonu waea yai agida iauya‑numa vaniahai, taui Iamesa ka vaneina Ioni ka amai tauna ana wava Sebedi. Ka Iesu Iamesa taina ainua honei.
Ka imini, ivo‑kwayavoni, e amai waea ini‑tawanei, ivi‑putu Iesu ivi‑muniei.
Iesu Yana Dewa

Iesu papani Galili habuhabuna tutu‑vivina, ka meagai aitamoata aitamoata yai manua tapanono nihenia viwavenei, ka Vaneana Ahiahina Yaubada ya pai veimea wayahina naunau‑waheyei, kadu tomotau ai kwanaha aitamoata aitamoata kadu muya aitamoata aitamoata vo‑vi‑aiaia.

Wayahina, Iesu yana dewa vaneana neine papani Siria meagaina habuhabuna wayahia, e inononi. Akaka papani Siria a tau maꞌ ine, e tau kwanakwanaha habuhabui iomanei Iesu wayahina. Taui tupwai ivi‑kwanaha ananina, ka tupwai inini viviha, kadu tupwai nua goyogoyoi iveimeyei inaunau‑wanana, e tupwai ai kwanaha wayahina inini si‑bananaitena, kadue tupwai tau penapena. Ka Iesu habuhabui vo‑vi‑aiaiei ividoha.

Wayahina, yoko ananina ivi‑putu Iesu ivi‑muniei. Tomotaui tau maꞌ papani Galili wayahina, ka papani Dekapolisi wayahina, kadue tau maꞌ Ierusalem wayahina, ka papani Iudea wayahina, ka kadu taui Daudau Ioridani papanina wayahina.

footnotes.text: Me Isiraeli Satana ivi‑wahani nua goyogoyoi ai tau veimea kadu ivi‑wahani tau vito‑nubu.
